integrity: The mathematical proof and finite verifier are included; the review is not independent and no external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact valuation is proved for 1-run lengths 4 mod 5; other run lengths remain outside scope. The published run-length transform theorem is a cited premise; unindexed equivalent work may exist. Finite verification does not establish infinite cases.
title: Exact 2-adic valuations on a Mersenne stratum of a binomial-parity run-length transform
